subject: Next steps: SIG kickoff & evidence pack request for MedProc
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@medproc.com>, Sam Park <sam.park@medisector.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + SIG recommendation and next steps

Hi Elena / Sam —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Call highlights
- MedProc will use Redwood for patient-facing summarization in a US-hosted environment; primary workloads are short chat completions and document embeddings.
- Key compliance asks: SOC 2 attestation, BAA for HIPAA, and confirmation of EU data residency for a subset of analytics users.

Recommendation
- Based on the scope, we suggest initiating the SIG (Standardized Information Gathering) path first — it covers the vendor controls you care about and maps easily to SOC 2 evidence. CAIQ is also possible if you prefer the cloud-provider lens, but SIG aligns better with healthcare auditables.

Immediate evidence requests (what we can provide fast)
1) SOC 2 Type II attestation (we have the 2026 attestation PDF attached).
2) Architecture diagram & high-level dataflow showing hosting in us-west-2 and how PHI is isolated.
3) Data retention / logs policy (we retain inference logs for 90 days by default; can extend per contract).
4) Draft BAA — attached a Redwood template (Draft_BAA_MedProc.docx) for legal review.

Next steps (proposed cadence)
- Today: Confirm SIG vs CAIQ preference (reply to this thread).
- By Thu 22 Apr: MedProc to confirm hosting residency requirement (US-only vs EU subset).
- By Tue 27 Apr: Redwood to drop a prefilled SIG sheet (we’ll send the XLSX) and a short evidence bundle (SOC 2, network diagram, retention policy).

Attachments referenced: MedProc_SIG_Questions_v1.xlsx (we’ll prefill once you confirm SIG); SOC2-Redwood-Attestation-2026.pdf; Draft_BAA_MedProc.docx

If that timeline works I’ll loop in Monica (operations) to put the evidence bundle together.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Sales 
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@medproc.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Park <sam.park@medisector.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + SIG recommendation and next steps

Thanks Ben — great summary. We’re comfortable starting with SIG. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Residency: Primary data (PHI) must remain in the US. We have a small analytics product team in Dublin that will need de-identified embeddings; we can document that as a separate EU subset (so US hosting for PHI + EU for de-id analytics).

2) SOC 2: Good to have the 2026 attestation — can you confirm whether the scope covered access controls for model inference logs and key management? We need to show auditors logging + KMS controls.

3) Retention: 90 days default is acceptable but we need the contractual ability to set 12-month retention for a specific bucket for our QA environment. Is that supported?

4) BAA: We’ll review the draft but legal will want to see the proposed plan for how PHI is encrypted in transit and at rest (high level is fine).

If you can send the prefilled SIG by EOD tomorrow that would let us start internal review.

—Elena
Elena Ruiz
Head of IT Compliance, MedProc Solutions

Jordan / Monica — looping you in to coordinate the deliverables for MedProc (deal MP-54321). Key asks from Elena: 

- Confirm SOC 2 scope includes inference logs and KMS controls; pull the relevant control narratives + evidence (logging config snippets, KMS key rotation policy).
- Prepare an architecture diagram that shows us-west-2 tenancy + network boundary for PHI, plus a separate EU de-id flow.
- Confirm whether we can support configurable retention per bucket and a contractual option to set 12 months for their QA bucket. If not, please propose alternatives.

Timeline: Elena asked for a prefilled SIG by EOD Tue 20 Apr (they want to start legal review). Can we assemble a short evidence bundle and prefill the XLSX by tomorrow EOD? If you need me to push deadlines with the customer, I can.

Attachments to include in the bundle: SOC2-Redwood-Attestation-2026.pdf (attached to original), network diagram PDF, logging policy snippet (text).

Thanks — Ben
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@medproc.com>, Sam Park <sam.park@medisector.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + SIG recommendation and next steps

Elena — thanks for the fast reply. Summary and actions we’ll take (confirming answers inline):

1) Residency: Confirmed — PHI in US (us-west-2). We’ll document EU de-identified flow for analytics.

2) SOC 2 scope: Yes — the 2026 attestation covers access controls and logging for inference services; I’ve attached the attestation PDF and flagged the relevant sections for auditors (page 4-6 shows logging and key management controls).

3) Retention: We support configurable retention per dataset/bucket. We can offer a contractual option to retain QA bucket logs for 12 months. I’ll flag that to legal in the BAA and SOW.

4) BAA: Uploaded a draft BAA for your review and a short checklist of encryption-in-transit and at-rest controls.

Deliverables we’re sharing now: 
- Prefilled SIG sheet (MedProc_SIG_Questions_v1.xlsx) — link to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cMedProcSIG
- SOC attestation: SOC2-Redwood-Attestation-2026.pdf (attached)
- Draft BAA uploaded to DocuSign for signature: https://www.docusign.com/MP-BAA-123

Next steps:
- Elena: legal review of draft BAA + confirmation on EU de-id users by Thu 22 Apr.
- Jordan / Monica: please drop the evidence bundle (diagram, logging snippets, KMS narrative) into the Drive folder by EOD Tue 20 Apr.

If anything changes I’ll update the timeline — otherwise we’ll treat this as SIG kickstart.

Cheers,
Ben

Attachments: SOC2-Redwood-Attestation-2026.pdf, MedProc_SIG_Questions_v1.xlsx, Draft_BAA_MedProc.docx
